prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 部分A股个股行情一览 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "代码" · longest unbreakable word 66px · one-line width 66px
  col 2: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
  col 3: header "最新价" · longest unbreakable word 67px · one-line width 67px
  col 4: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 60px
  col 5: header "成交额（亿）" · longest unbreakable word 52px · one-line width 104px
  col 6: header "市盈率" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 53px
  col 7: header "所属行业" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 496px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 495px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示部分A股个股的行情，供读者按股票查看价格、涨跌、成交、市盈率和行业。","reading":"读者先用代码或名称定位股票，再横向读取同一行，并纵向比较各项指标。行高由名称或行业换行决定；较短的表头可在已有高度中换行。","groups":["代码和名称共同标识股票，应便于对应同一行。","最新价、涨跌幅、成交额和市盈率都是需要纵向比较的数值指标。","名称和所属行业都是中文标签，可以按字符换行，但应尽量保留两个字的词组。"],"keep_intact":["股票代码","价格、涨跌幅、成交额和市盈率的数值，包括小数点、符号和百分号"],"may_wrap":["公司名称和行业名称可在汉字之间换行，尽量避免逐字竖排。","成交额（亿）、市盈率和所属行业等表头可换行；表头换行可共用表头行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [87, 55, 88, 81, 73, 60, 51] · table 496×803px · row heights [118, 118, 118, 118, 92, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [87, 51, 88, 81, 73, 60, 55] · table 496×803px · row heights [118, 118, 118, 118, 92, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [87, 53, 88, 81, 73, 60, 53] · table 496×803px · row heights [118, 118, 118, 118, 92, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"代码和各项数值保持完整，股票标识与指标的横向对应清楚。成交额表头分两行，仍容易辨认。","problems":"名称逐字竖排，增加了行高，也使股票名称难以扫读；行业列较窄，较长行业名称同样被拆散。","cause":"名称列为55px、行业列为51px；它们扣除21px边距和边框后，中文标签可用宽度不足。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"画面中名称多能按两个字一组阅读，股票身份比逐字排列更容易识别；代码和数值完整。","problems":"行业名称及其表头被挤成竖排，长行业名称拉高行并削弱横向阅读。图中名称和行业的实际换行表现与所给列宽相对于r0A的变化方向不一致。","cause":"画面显示行业列只能容纳约一个汉字；但所列宽度为名称51px、行业55px，无法单凭这些数字解释画面中的相反表现。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"行业表头和多数行业名称能按词组阅读，右侧更整齐；数值与代码保持完整。","problems":"名称逐字竖排，定位股票变慢，长名称也使整行留出大量空白。","cause":"名称和行业各为53px，扣除边距和边框后，名称列在此渲染中不足以并排容纳两个汉字。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"名称优先","widths":[87,57,88,81,73,60,49],"change":"将名称加宽至57px，把行业压至49px，检验能否让股票名称按两字一组阅读；代码及数值列维持完整所需宽度。"},{"name":"行业优先","widths":[87,49,88,81,73,60,57],"change":"将行业加宽至57px，检验行业表头及较长行业名称的换行，作为名称优先方案的对照。"}]}
